assets.name: Noon Bailiff

canonical.anatomy: A faceless bronze officer balanced on one vertical gavel-limb, with a second body made only from its confiscated shadow.
canonical.ecology: It serves warrants against actions the restored law predicts a person will eventually commit.
canonical.origin: A mortal court asked daylight to reveal perfect evidence; the answer arrived after the courthouse had no defendants left.
canonical.cue: The flat shadow completes the player's next animation before the solid Bailiff moves.
canonical.counterplay: Begin one action and cancel into a different facing during the silent verdict gap.
canonical.narrativeUse: Forces settlements to decide whether preventing certain harm justifies punishment before choice.
canonical.visualBrief: Narrow bronze-white herald, one gavel leg, one attached prophetic shadow, mouthless judicial veil, no weapon or written warrant.

assets.name: Engine of the Unbroken Note

canonical.anatomy: A hovering organ of thirteen pale pipes arranged around one black silent pipe that is physically unable to sound.
canonical.ecology: It stabilizes failing natural law by holding one note until local change becomes impossible.
canonical.origin: Deacon Halix commissioned a choir that could never forget its pitch; the first performance also prevented its listeners from aging, healing, or leaving.
canonical.cue: Twelve sounding pipes frost while the single black pipe remains warm and silent.
canonical.counterplay: Route an environmental sound through the black pipe to introduce a lawful rest into the note.
canonical.narrativeUse: May freeze a dying village safely forever or release it into accumulated centuries at once.
canonical.visualBrief: Angelic organ-engine, exactly thirteen countable pipes with one black silent exception, restrained light, no floating notation or choir scene.

assets.name: Reliquary of the Last Breath

canonical.anatomy: A wingless floating chest whose ribs are rows of sealed glass breath-vials surrounding one intentionally empty cradle.
canonical.ecology: It collects final breaths and rebuilds useful dead as idealized versions stripped of inconvenient loyalties.
canonical.origin: A plague hospice donated its last exhalations to the promised dawn and discovered the contract did not define who would breathe them next.
canonical.cue: One empty cradle-vial clouds while all occupied vials clear.
canonical.counterplay: Break only the empty vial, causing the attempted resurrection to return the target's refused memory instead of its body.
canonical.narrativeUse: Provides resurrection that can save a beloved character while editing why they mattered.
canonical.visualBrief: Beautiful white-gold reliquary chest, many sealed vials, one conspicuous empty cradle, no corpse, spirit, labels, or readable scripture.
